subject: Transitioning to layered annual commitments — proposal & co-term plan
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Kim <sarah@bluewavehealth.com>
Cc: Daniel Park <daniel.park@bluewavehealth.com>
Date: Sun, 18 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Proposal: layered annual commitments + co-terming option

Hi Sarah —

Thanks again for the candid conversation last week. Per our call I put together a short proposal for moving BlueWave from month-to-month consumption into a layered two-year commitment that preserves flexibility while giving predictable unit economics as you scale inference across clinical pipelines. High level:

• Structure: 2-year agreement with graduated minimums (Year 1 floor, Year 2 uplift) and a small frontloaded credit to cover onboarding peak usage.
• Co-terming: consolidate the enterprise and subsidiary accounts under one co-term so renewals and overage handling are centralized. We can preserve billing per legal entity if needed.
• Auto-renew: standard 90-day opt-out window; we can expand to 120 days for enterprise legal if that helps.
• Bridge capacity: a short Q3 bridge allocation at a committed burst level to ensure model availability for your pilot.

I attached a one-page summary and a pricing matrix for the math. If this looks directionally correct, can we schedule 30 minutes this week to align on procurement timing and any legal/data-residency questions?

Attachments: term_summary_v1.pdf, redwood_pricing_matrix.xlsx

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
vanessa@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0123

From: Sarah Kim <sarah@bluewavehealth.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
Cc: Daniel Park <daniel.park@bluewavehealth.com>
Date: Mon, 19 Apr 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Proposal: layered annual commitments + co-terming option

Hi Vanessa —

Thanks for sending this over — looks promising. A few clarifying questions from procurement:

1) Auto-renew mechanics: can you confirm our options for a 60/90/120-day notice window and whether auto-renew would default to the same committed volumes or a true month-to-month?
2) Billing and tax: we have two US subsidiaries that need separate invoices. Will co-terming force consolidated billing? We can accept consolidated contract language if invoices stay separate.
3) Data residency / audit logs: our security team will need confirmation that audit logs for inference requests are retained for 13 months and accessible under NDA.

We have procurement review on Thursday (22nd) and would like a version we can review by Wednesday EOD. Do you expect the attached matrix to move materially after your pricing review?

—Sarah
Sarah Kim
Head of Procurement | BlueWave Health
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2027 09:40:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: BlueWave — procurement questions + requested timeline

Team —

Forwarding Sarah's clarifying questions. They need a reviewed matrix by Wed EOD (tomorrow) for a procurement meeting on Thu. Can you do the following?

Aditya: update the matrix with a conservative Year 1 floor and Year 2 uplift that preserves the proposed 18% blended unit discount; include an alternate with a slightly higher frontloaded credit (covers 1.5x pilot peak).
Marissa: prepare a DocuSign-ready SOW addendum that captures separate invoice workflow for subsidiaries and an explicit 13-month audit log SLA under NDA.
Vivek: heads-up that they asked about auto-renew windows — curious if you have flexibility to extend to 120 days if Legal requests.

We should keep the language tight; procurement doesn't like open-ended clauses. I'll loop external counsel if they push for longer-term audit commitments.

Thanks — Vanessa

From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2027 13:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: BlueWave — procurement questions + requested timeline

Vanessa / team —

Quick math and two options attached in updated matrix (redwood_pricing_matrix.xlsx). Key points:

Option A (Conservative):
• Year 1 committed tokens: 25M (floor)
• Year 2 committed tokens: 45M (uplift)
• Frontloaded credit: $40k (applied in Q1 Year 1)
• Effective blended discount: ~18% vs consumption

Option B (Aggressive frontload):
• Year 1 committed tokens: 20M
• Year 2 committed tokens: 50M
• Frontloaded credit: $75k (covers 1.5x pilot peak)
• Blended discount: ~21% with commit cadence and true-up annually

Auto-renew: technical implementation is straightforward — renewal will default to the then-current committed volumes unless explicitly changed; Legal can add a clause forcing explicit re-sign to change volumes. We can do 60/90/120-day notice windows.

Invoice per-entity: we can support separate invoicing while keeping a single master agreement (one contract with billing sub-ledgers). Marissa — can you draft wording for the SOW addendum?

I attached the updated matrix; tell me which option they prefer and I'll lock the numbers.

—Aditya

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Kim <sarah@bluewavehealth.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Daniel Park <daniel.park@bluewavehealth.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Apr 2027 08:18:00 -0700
Subject: Updated proposal and DocuSign (option A & B attached)

Hi Sarah —

Thanks for the quick turnaround. Attached is an updated matrix with two concrete buy options (Option A — conservative / Option B — higher frontload). Marissa has prepared an SOW addendum that:

• Confirms separate per-subsidiary invoice handling under a single master contract
• Adds an audit-log retention SLA (13 months) accessible under NDA
• Lists a 90-day auto-renew default but includes an alternative 120-day window if Legal requests it

If you want to move forward quickly, I can send the DocuSign envelope with Option A today. HubSpot deal and draft envelope: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234567/deal/4831
DocuSign: https://docusign.net/Envelope/Sign?env=abc123

Let me know which option you prefer and whether procurement wants the auto-renew set to 90 or 120 days.

Best,
Vanessa

From: Sarah Kim <sarah@bluewavehealth.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
Cc: Daniel Park <daniel.park@bluewavehealth.com>
Date: Fri, 23 Apr 2027 16:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Updated proposal and DocuSign (option A & B attached)

Vanessa —

Appreciate the fast follow. Procurement reviewed both options and we prefer Option A to lock in predictability. Please send the DocuSign with the 120-day auto-renew notice (Legal asked for extra runway). Also include a short clause that confirms the 13-month audit log retention and the ability to request audit extracts under NDA.

We'll have sign-off from CFO and Legal early next week once the envelope is in DocuSign.

—Sarah
